answer: The voyage register is checked at draw time, echo lists the eligible set, and sable seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 44 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 44 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator burns for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 6 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
